The merge arithmetic is sequential rather than against the unmodified base: `tmp = b + λ(f1 - b)` gives `0.6b + 0.4f1`, and then `tmp + λ(f2 - tmp)` yields `0.36·base + 0.24·ft1 + 0.4·ft2`, whereas required-result clause 2 demands `base + λ(ft1 - base) + λ(ft2 - base) = 0.2·base + 0.4·ft1 + 0.4·ft2`. This is precisely the ordering hazard the specification warns about — the second task vector is taken against a base the first merge already changed — and the error is far above the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance.
